access.authorization: The official OpenAPI contract lookup has security=[] and is a public GET. The bounded live request sent no Authorization header.
access.free_access_evidence: Official API docs state that the full verified-contract database is available as a free Parquet dataset and public BigQuery dataset; API docs document the unauthenticated single-contract GET. No paid API route or key is used.
access.qualification_limit: One exact Base USDC lookup returned an identity-matched minimal record. This does not qualify other chains/contracts, provider uptime, or security outcomes.

route.task: single exact EVM contract verification metadata lookup
identity: exact positive decimal EVM chain ID
exact 20-byte contract address, EVM comparison case-insensitive
returned chainId and address must match the request
route.response_scope: Default minimal API response only; no sources, ABI, metadata, standard JSON input/output, or verification submission is requested.
route.timestamps: retrieved_at_utc is local retrieval time. provider_verified_at_utc is Sourcify's verifiedAt metadata, not deployment or event time.
route.interpretation: A match reports bytecode/source verification status. It is not a security audit, proof of correct intent, or guarantee a token is safe; missing/unverified status is not a risk verdict.
route.upstream_lineage: Sourcify verified-contract database. This lookup does not expose the RPC or original verification-submission lineage used for every stored record.
route.independence: Do not count as independent risk corroboration of GoPlus or another security heuristic.

request_policy.documented_rate_limit: Requests are rate-limited per client; official docs do not state a numeric public limit. Honor Retry-After and stop on 429/5xx; do not auto-retry.
request_policy.local_budget: At most one GET per invocation; exact-contract persistent cache prevents repeat positive lookups across invocations.
request_policy.positive_cache: Persist minimal successful positive verification metadata indefinitely, as Sourcify asks callers to store and reuse contract responses and not fetch the same contract again.
request_policy.negative_cache: Persist a no-match response for one hour before permitting a recheck because a contract can be verified later.
request_policy.cache_location: OS temporary directory under fin-dex/sourcify-contract-cache-v1; stores only validated minimal verification metadata, not source files.

prior_bad_request.handling: No repeat request was made for this contract; adapter uses the documented default minimal field set.
